$note: Extracted 6 Aug 2026. Primary source PDF has a corrupted/non-standard font encoding that garbles LETTERS in pdftotext output (e.g. 'SINGLE' renders as 'SlN(;I,F,') but NUMBERS render correctly - this was independently verified by rendering pages 1-2 to PNG (150dpi) and visually cross-checking every rate cell against the pdftotext numeric output. All figures below are confirmed via that visual cross-check, not text-extraction alone. NOT a Soroi property. Covers THREE lodges under one contract: Mara Simba Lodge, Samburu Simba Lodge, Lake Naivasha Simba Lodge.
currency: USD (non-resident, this contract) / KES (separate resident-rate PDFs, reference only)

generalTerms.note: All rates in US Dollars, non-resident clients only, inclusive of all taxes, net of commission.
generalTerms.halfBoardReduction: Reduce USD 2.00 per person per night from Full Board rate.
generalTerms.roomAllocation: Max 4 single rooms given at single rate, rest at double rate.
generalTerms.roadPackageFreebie: 1 adult sharing free for every 15 paying adults on Road Package only (max 4 tour leaders), non-residents only.
generalTerms.groundPackageInclusions: 2 game drives on sharing basis, airport transfers Mara/Samburu on sharing basis, Full Board accommodation. Excludes beverages, extra lunch, park fees, flight and other extra services.
generalTerms.circuitDiscount: 2 nights Mara + 1 night Naivasha + 2 nights Samburu (5 nights total) = 5% off contract rate for lodge accommodation only. Does not apply to Extra Services rates or Luxury Tent Supplement.

childPolicy.childSharingWithOneAdult: Charged single room rate PLUS children's rate
